The runner explicitly requests level, spectral-centroid and attacks. Use only the new v5 independent-metric pipeline. If a call fails, stop and report it: do not retry, repair, seek, stop playback, change settings, edit the Set or use another listener. After the first get-pass, if it is nonterminal, immediately finish your turn with pending. Never call get-pass twice, poll or wait: the harness owns the terminal wait. Only after completed may you get the context with includeHistorical=true. Leave playback running. Report measured level, spectral-centroid and attack availability without claiming exclusive clip audio. Capture one eight-bar 4/4 phrase (32 beats, 15 seconds) at constant128 BPM with no tempo automation. The harness has prepared and hash-pinned a copied 64-beat first-iteration source; never loop a shorter source, extend it, change tempo or repair it yourself. All quarter-beat rows, independent attack-input windows and phase-sensitive FFT records must remain available in the saved and reopened context.
